In article <70049e$58b$1...@nnrp1.dejanews.com>, mad...@rocketmail.com
writes
>Ok, if I use a Dramatic Upheavel to switch places with my grandprey, or even
>my prey, who's turn does it become?

It was your turn before you played the card. It is still your turn
after you play the card. Why should it be any different?

> Is this, in fact, and evil way to keep
>people from getting a turn if you have to?

Yes. See also, Reversal of Fortunes.
